current: In each iteration: \begin{enumerate}[itemsep=0pt, topsep=1pt] \item step~1: a LightGBM classifier (100 trees, 8 leaves, learning rate 0.1, deterministic; :143--148) separates the reconstructed simulated events that have a reconstructed partner, weighted $\omega_i w^{\mathrm{reco}}_i$, from the refined measured rows, weighted $\nu$, and each such event receives $u_i=p/(1-p)$ at its reconstructed values, with $p$ restricted as above (:152--155); \item events without a reconstructed partner receive $u_i$ from a LightGBM regressor of the same capacity, fitted to $u$ on the truth coordinates of the events that have one (:258--260); \item the pull weight is $\pi_i=\omega_i u_i$ (:261); \item step~2: a second classifier separates the truth coordinates weighted $w^{\mathrm{truth}}_i$ from the same coordinates weighted $\pi_i w^{\mathrm{truth}}_i$, and $\omega_i=p/(1-p)$ at each event's truth coordinates (:263--266).
